exercises.question: Which sentence evaluates a work? [¿Cuál evalúa una obra?]
options: El argumento resulta convincente. [The plot is convincing.]
La película dura dos horas. [The film lasts two hours.]
El personaje se llama Luis. [The character is called Luis.]

exercises.sentence: El argumento resulta __. (convincente) [The plot is convincing.]

sentences: El argumento resulta convincente. [The plot is convincing.]
Los personajes están bien desarrollados. [The characters are well developed.]
La película me parece original y entretenida. [The film seems original and entertaining to me.]

exercises.question: Which word describes the storyline? [¿Qué palabra describe la historia principal?]
options: argumento [plot]
personaje [character]
canción [song]

exercises.sentence: La película me parece __ y entretenida. (original) [The film seems original and entertaining to me.]

exercises.english: The story does not seem very interesting to me.

options: The plot is convincing.
The plot is confusing.
The plot is very short.
The characters are well developed.
The characters are badly chosen.
The characters are missing.

exercises.sentence: La película me parece original y entretenida.
La historia no me parece demasiado interesante.
options: The story does not seem very interesting to me.
The story is definitely the best.
The story is not a story.
Resulta convincente. [It is convincing.]
Resultará convincente ayer. [It will be convincing yesterday.]
Resultaba convincente mañana. [It was convincing tomorrow.]
Están bien desarrollados. [They are well developed.]
Estarán bien desarrollados ayer. [They will be well developed yesterday.]
Estaban bien desarrollados mañana. [They were well developed tomorrow.]
Sí, me parece original y entretenida. [Yes, it seems original and entertaining to me.]
Sí, me pareció mañana. [Yes, it seemed to me tomorrow.]
Sí, me parecería ayer. [Yes, it would seem to me yesterday.]

template.prompt: Evaluate a film by commenting on its plot and characters.
template.answer: El argumento resulta convincente y los personajes están bien desarrollados.

template.prompt: Give a positive and a negative evaluation.
template.answer: La película me parece original, aunque algunas escenas no son demasiado interesantes.
